channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Adrian Griffin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Adrian Griffin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jon Horst on Adrian Griffin
item.description:
Assistant GM Milt Newton said Griffin was a head coach who hadn't been given an opportunity yet, said Horst.

“We all landed on Adrian being the candidate that we recommend to take this job,”

Jon Horst on Adrian Griffin, Jun 7, 2023. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Adrian Griffin
item.description:
Nick Nurse on Adrian Griffin:

“He’s a class individual: hard-working guy ... I’ve known him for a long time and wanted to give him this opportunity to help his career professionally. The rest ... he categorically denies ... and we stand with him, and so does our organization.”

Nick Nurse on Adrian Griffin, Aug 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @SmithRaps.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Adrian Griffin
item.description:
“Adrian was a candidate to come back here as a lead, but I'm still in the process of making that decision,”

Frank Vogel on Adrian Griffin, Jun 9, 2016. Source: Orlando Sentinel.
